attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 31 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry enumerates two people, husband and wife, each with a heading, so it is two folders. The corpus keeps three other Seleucuses and none of them is married to a Stratonice: of Cappadocia on 16 February, the martyr with Gordian on 13 September, and one kept by date on 23 May. There is no Stratonice in the corpus at all. The page gives no year, no city and no persecutor, so no `dates` object and no location. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (1 October 2026).
